metadata.title: QQQ ETF edges higher as Nasdaq-100 outperforms - MarketWatch

content.text:
8 hours ago
QQQ ETF edges higher as Nasdaq-100 outperforms
A popular exchange-traded fund that tracks the technology-heavy Nasdaq-100 index was outperforming Friday, as a rally in semiconductor stocks provided a lift in early afternoon trading.
The Invesco QQQ Trust Series I, whose top holding as recently as Thursday was chip giant Nvidia, was up 0.1% in Friday afternoon trading. The ETF’s top 10 holdings also included semiconductor companies Micron Technology and Advanced Micro Devices, both of which were posting big gains in Friday's trading that exceeded Nvidia’s sharp rise.
Meanwhile, the U.S. stock market was broadly lower, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite Index all down in afternoon trading, FactSet data showed, at last check.
